scope: Effective recipe policy plus inspected actor adapters; not human acceptance or full dependency audit.

rows.name: Flood
rows.player_rule: Grounded directional flow; jump or leave the current.
rows.eligibility_caution: all eligible grounded actors; root adapter has no hostile filter

rows.name: Mud
rows.player_rule: Ordinary-ground acceleration and braking become 70%; target speed unchanged. Leave to restore.

rows.name: Steam
rows.player_rule: Transparent escalating scald through height 48 px. Leave; a fresh Water cast can cool once. A low hop is not immunity.
rows.eligibility_caution: root pressure query includes self/allies; no hostile filter

rows.name: Mistcurrent
rows.player_rule: Wet directional steering with finite suppression; jump or exit laterally. Not concealment.

rows.name: Rampart
rows.player_rule: Temporary breakable six-face cover; go around, break or wait. No assumed vaulting.
rows.eligibility_caution: structure rules need missing HexStructures dependency

rows.name: Magma
rows.player_rule: Grounded hostile damage; ordinary-ground target speed 75%, no after-exit slow. Jump or leave.
rows.eligibility_caution: movement all unprotected; damage hostile unprotected

rows.name: Dustfront
rows.player_rule: Transparent lateral ground push; jump or exit sideways.

rows.name: Conflagration
rows.player_rule: Grounded burn pulses every 72 ticks. Leave/jump during warning.
rows.eligibility_caution: all eligible grounded actors; root adapter has no hostile filter

rows.name: Firestorm
rows.player_rule: Moving damaging route cut; use lateral exit or solid cover. Do not promise a low-hop dodge.

rows.name: Vortex
rows.player_rule: Grounded tangential push; use an actually unselected opening, jump or leave. Analytic center is not automatically safe after whole-cell selection.
